sv.title: Fallet Malin: Pappa pressades av socialtjänsten
sv.summary: Malins son omhändertogs när han var tre dagar – på felaktiga grunder. Nu berättar pappan om hur han pressades av socialtjänsten att peka ut Malin för att inte förlora sonen. – Jag fick kasta henne under bussen. Annars hade Leo inte haft någon pappa heller, säger han till SVT:s Uppdrag granskning.

en.title: The Malin case: Father was pressured by social services
en.summary: Malin's son was taken into care when he was three days old – on wrong grounds. Now the father describes how social services pressured him to point out Malin in order not to lose his son. "I had to throw her under the bus. Otherwise Leo wouldn't have had a father either," he tells SVT's Uppdrag granskning.
